display_long_description:
🎧 MixMaster VR
The world's first VR home for electronic music. Your headset is your ticket.
Mixmaster transforms your VR headset into a portal to the global EDM scene. This isn't watching a concert on a screen, it's being there. Pull on your headset, create your avatar, and step onto a living, breathing dance floor surrounded by real people from every corner of the planet. The bass hits, the lights move, the crowd roars and you're right in the middle of it.
No ticket lines. No borders. No last call. Just you and the music, any time you want it.
Three ways to experience live music:
🎶 Virtual Concerts - Fully immersive shows where artist avatars perform live on a virtual stage and you dance in the crowd with fans worldwide.
📡 Live 360° Streams - Real-world events beamed straight into VR through 360° cameras, placing you front-and-center at the venue as it happens as if you're really there. Can't get to the show? The show comes to you.
🏛️ VR Event Replicas - Faithful, hand-built recreations of real-world events, rebuilt inside VR so you can step into legendary shows and experience them again and again.
Make it yours.
Create and fully customise your own avatar, the way the whole crowd will see you. Express your style, stand out on the dance floor, and show up as unmistakably you.
🎟️ Grab tickets right inside the app and unlock exclusive live events. You'll be notified when your event goes live.
Download Mixmaster free and step inside the music.
